run_inference_on_datasets: run inference on one or more datasets using a trained Fast R-CNN network with Caffe2
test_fast_rcnn_network: test a Fast R-CNN network by running inference with a config file and model weights
run_multi_gpu_inference: run multi-GPU inference testing using cfg.NUM_GPUS for parallel detection on datasets
run_inference_with_range: run inference on a specific range of dataset indices using start and end index arguments
visualize_detections: run inference and visualize object detections on test dataset images with the vis flag
